description: Load one of your skills: the full instructions for doing something, which the turn only announced by name. Do it BEFORE working in a skill's area rather than after -- the announcement says what a skill is for, and the skill itself says how, including which calls to make and what not to do. Pass a section name to load only part of it. A skill may also carry FILES it tells you to read -- a lookup table, a mapping -- and `resources` names them; pass one as `resource` to be given it. Asking for a skill, a section or a resource that does not exist returns the ones that do.

resource.description: One file the skill carries, by name, as `resources` lists them.

section.description: One section of it, by heading. Omit for the whole skill.

skill.description: Which skill, by the name the turn announced.

name: load_skill
